title: "Time Controls Popularity"

```{=html}
<div class="rc">
  <section class="rc-page" id="queues">
    <div class="rc-grid">
      <div class="rc-card rc-wide" id="q3-share-card">
        <h2>Share of lobby games by category</h2>
        <p class="rc-note">Each month's rated lobby games split by category. Rapid arrived in November 2017, taking the 8 to 25 minute games from the old Classical.</p>
        <ul class="rc-legend">
          <li><span class="rc-sw" data-swatch="cat:UltraBullet"></span>UltraBullet</li>
          <li><span class="rc-sw" data-swatch="cat:Bullet"></span>Bullet</li>
          <li><span class="rc-sw" data-swatch="cat:Blitz"></span>Blitz</li>
          <li><span class="rc-sw" data-swatch="cat:Rapid"></span>Rapid</li>
          <li><span class="rc-sw" data-swatch="cat:Classical (pre-Nov 2017)"></span>Classical (pre-Nov 2017)</li>
          <li><span class="rc-sw" data-swatch="cat:Classical"></span>Classical</li>
          <li><span class="rc-sw" data-swatch="cat:Correspondence"></span>Correspondence</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="rc-chart dash-skeleton" id="q3-share" data-draw="q3-share"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="rc-controls">
      <label class="rc-field">Category
        <select class="rc-q3group" id="q3-group">
          <option>UltraBullet</option><option>Bullet</option><option>Blitz</option><option>Rapid</option><option>Classical</option><option>Classical (pre-Nov 2017)</option><option>Correspondence</option>
        </select>
      </label>
    </div>
    <div class="rc-card" id="q3-monthly-card">
      <h2>Games per day in each <span data-draw="q3-word" data-word="group">—</span> time control</h2>
      <p class="rc-note">Average rated lobby games started per day, by month: a stand-in for how many people are in each queue. "other" is every remaining time control in the category.</p>
      <div class="rc-chart rc-chart-tall dash-skeleton" id="q3-monthly" data-draw="q3-monthly"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="rc-controls">
      <label class="rc-field">Year
        <select id="q3-year" data-draw="q3-year"></select>
      </label>
    </div>
    <div class="rc-card" id="q3-heat-card">
      <h2>When the queues are busy, <span data-draw="q3-year-word">—</span></h2>
      <p class="rc-note">Games started in each hour of the day, US Pacific time. Each row is shaded from its own quietest hour (lightest) to its busiest (darkest, with a dot) in five steps, so you can see when each queue fills up whatever its size. The right-hand column is busiest hour ÷ quietest hour: the bigger it is, the more your wait depends on when you play.</p>
      <ul class="rc-legend" aria-label="Shading key">
        <li>Quietest</li>
        <li><span class="rc-sw" style="background:#cde2fb"></span><span class="rc-sw" style="background:#9ec5f4"></span><span class="rc-sw" style="background:#6da7ec"></span><span class="rc-sw" style="background:#3987e5"></span><span class="rc-sw" style="background:#1c5cab"></span></li>
        <li>Busiest hour of that time control</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="rc-chart dash-skeleton" id="q3-heat" data-draw="q3-heat"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="rc-card" id="q3-band-card">
      <h2>Games near your rating, by hour</h2>
      <div class="rc-controls">
        <label class="rc-field">Time control
          <select id="q3-tc" data-draw="q3-tc"></select>
        </label>
        <label class="rc-field">Rating band (average of the two players)
          <input type="number" class="rc-q3band" id="q3-band" min="400" max="3000" step="100">
        </label>
      </div>
      <p class="rc-note">Games per hour in <span data-draw="q3-band-stat" data-stat="peak" data-field="year">—</span> where the two players averaged <span data-draw="q3-word" data-word="band">—</span>. Busiest at <b data-draw="q3-band-stat" data-stat="peak" data-field="hour">—</b> Pacific time with <b data-draw="q3-band-stat" data-stat="peak" data-field="games_per_hour">—</b> games an hour; quietest at <b data-draw="q3-band-stat" data-stat="low" data-field="hour">—</b> Pacific time with <b data-draw="q3-band-stat" data-stat="low" data-field="games_per_hour">—</b>.</p>
      <div class="rc-chart dash-skeleton" id="q3-band-chart" data-draw="q3-band"></div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <p class="rc-note">Based on <span data-draw="corpus" data-field="games">—</span> rated Lichess lobby games from <span data-draw="corpus" data-field="first">—</span> through <span data-draw="corpus" data-field="last">—</span>. The counts exclude tournaments and known bots.</p>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js"></script>
```
